verdicts.reason: A keeps the full message, but the date card is shrunk into the top-right corner, so 'SAT', 'NOV' and '8 PM–1 AM' are barely readable. Its eyebrow sits awkwardly above a centred logo while the headline is left-aligned, and the inset pattern strip at the bottom looks cramped. Still, the headline, controller and CTA read well. B shrinks the date card and controller to unreadable specks in the footer, which loses the event date. Its body copy is microscopic, the eyebrow ends up below the CTA, which scrambles the reading order, and a huge cropped piece of the decorative pattern takes over as the hero image, so B is unusable.
